_about: Public-domain Theodore L. Cuyler (1822-1909), pastor of Lafayette Avenue Presbyterian Church, Brooklyn, for the Word Hoard: The Empty Crib (1868), Pointed Papers for the Christian Life (1879), God's Light on Dark Clouds (1882), How to Be a Pastor (1890), Stirring the Eagle's Nest (1892), The Young Preacher (1893) and Recollections of a Long Life (1902), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

tlcuyler-empty-crib: The Empty Crib: A Memorial of Little Georgie, with Words of Consolation for Bereaved Parents (New York: R. Carter and Brothers; entered 1868)

tlcuyler-young-preacher: The Young Preacher (New York and Chicago: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1893)
